question: List the methods in Thread class.
answerMd:
### Core Methods of the `java.lang.Thread` Class

| Method | Syntax | Functional Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **`start()`** | `void start()` | Allocates native thread stack and invokes `run()` asynchronously. |
| **`run()`** | `void run()` | Contains the executable entry point code for the thread. |
| **`sleep()`** | `static void sleep(long ms)` | Suspends current thread for specified milliseconds; retains held locks. |
| **`join()`** | `void join()` | Pauses the calling thread until the referenced thread terminates. |
| **`isAlive()`** | `boolean isAlive()` | Returns `true` if thread has started and not yet terminated. |
| **`yield()`** | `static void yield()` | Hints scheduler that the current thread is willing to yield its CPU slice. |

$$\therefore \text{Thread control methods coordinate thread timing, sequencing, and state transitions.}$$
